asset.title: From Governed Knowledge to an Auditable Institutional Asset
asset.dek: A reference workflow for policy-aware, AI-assisted publishing with explicit human authorization.
body: Institutional publishing requires more than content generation. It requires traceable source material, applicable policies, specialist review, explicit authorization, and durable evidence of every decision.

The BBA Publisher Reference Demo models that lifecycle as a Mission. The Mission retrieves relevant policies, classifies the source, prepares an editorial brief, produces a draft Institutional Asset, and records review findings before a human can approve or reject release.

The browser demo intentionally replays a deterministic reference package. This keeps the build transparent and reproducible while allowing policy retrieval, workflow transitions, review handling, human authorization, and audit logging to execute locally.
The result is not a production publishing platform. It is an executable reference implementation showing how governed knowledge can become an auditable institutional asset.
